motions.label: Locked off
motions.instruction: The camera holds a locked static frame on the existing composition, without drift, reframing, or handheld float.
motions.head: The camera holds a locked static frame

motions.label: Zoom in
motions.instruction: The camera zooms in on the principal subject already present in the shot, tightening the framing optically while the camera body stays where it is.
motions.head: The camera zooms in

motions.label: Zoom out
motions.instruction: The camera zooms out from the principal subject already present in the shot, widening the framing optically while the camera body stays where it is.
motions.head: The camera zooms out

motions.label: Dolly in
motions.instruction: The camera pushes in toward the principal subject already present in the shot, in one continuous move that settles before the key beat.
motions.head: The camera pushes in

motions.label: Dolly out
motions.instruction: The camera pulls out away from the principal subject already present in the shot, revealing more of the space that is already around it.
motions.head: The camera pulls out

motions.label: Pan left
motions.instruction: The camera pans left from a fixed position, sweeping across the existing space and settling on the required action.
motions.head: The camera pans left

motions.label: Pan right
motions.instruction: The camera pans right from a fixed position, sweeping across the existing space and settling on the required action.
motions.head: The camera pans right

motions.label: Truck left
motions.instruction: The camera trucks left, travelling bodily sideways across the scene while keeping the required action inside the frame.
motions.head: The camera trucks left

motions.label: Truck right
motions.instruction: The camera trucks right, travelling bodily sideways across the scene while keeping the required action inside the frame.
motions.head: The camera trucks right

motions.label: Tilt up
motions.instruction: The camera tilts up from a fixed position, following the existing vertical line from the principal subject toward what is already above it.
motions.head: The camera tilts up

motions.label: Tilt down
motions.instruction: The camera tilts down from a fixed position, following the existing vertical line from the principal subject toward what is already below it.
motions.head: The camera tilts down

motions.label: Pedestal up
motions.instruction: The camera pedestals up, rising vertically on its axis while holding the same framing angle on the principal subject already present in the shot.
motions.head: The camera pedestals up

motions.label: Pedestal down
motions.instruction: The camera pedestals down, lowering vertically on its axis while holding the same framing angle on the principal subject already present in the shot.
motions.head: The camera pedestals down

motions.label: Orbit / arc
motions.instruction: The camera arcs around the principal subject already present in the shot, keeping it centred while the changing background reveals the existing depth.
motions.head: The camera arcs

motions.label: Track subject
motions.instruction: The camera tracks alongside the principal subject already present in the shot, holding a steady following distance as that subject moves.
motions.head: The camera tracks

motions.label: Handheld shake
motions.instruction: The camera shakes, handheld-style, while keeping the required action identifiable.
motions.head: The camera shakes

motions.label: Roll clockwise
motions.instruction: The camera rolls clockwise around the lens axis, canting the horizon progressively without moving the subject through the scene.
motions.head: The camera rolls clockwise

motions.label: Roll counter-clockwise
motions.instruction: The camera rolls counterclockwise around the lens axis, canting the horizon progressively without moving the subject through the scene.
motions.head: The camera rolls counterclockwise
